summary.en: While examining the email, Conan notices that the account on Facenet may be falsified. The suspicion falls on Risa's manager Yamane who previously made contact with Takeyama as he is angry with the latter actions toward Risa. As time is running out, Kogoro decides to appeal the public through Beika News Channel in order to reach the kidnappers and plead for them to release Ran.
